content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after the user edits Rate and clicks the \"Items\" label at about (450, 600), the page navigates to customer:list about 1.1 s later in all three sessions (click 602 to navigation app:15 at 13413 ms, click 608 to app:15 at 18831 ms, click 611 to app:15 at 22069 ms), followed by a console error. The \"Items\" label therefore appears to route the user away from the unsaved invoice form.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, change the \"Items\" label/tab control near (450, 600) so it switches to the items section in place instead of navigating to customer:list, or, if it must leave the form, save the draft or show an unsaved-changes prompt before the route change.", "cited_event_ids": ["602", "app:15", "608", "611", "571", "574", "581", "615", "621", "625"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the console errors and the handler or link target of the 'Items' label are not in the events.", "The visible error on Payment Due Date (events 353:a352, 355:a365, 360:a374) is not explained by the windows, and its role in the abandonment is unknown.", "Whether the user intended to navigate to customer:list is not observable.", "Repeated Rate clicks (567, 570, 573, 574, 576, 580) are not explained as a cause of leaving."]}
